heading: ADDENDUM: CUSTOMIZED SERVICE ARRANGEMENT FOR REFYNITY

items.p: This Addendum supplements the Client Services Agreement between Relève Staffing LLC (“Relève”) and Refynity (“Client”) and forms part of it.
The purpose of this Addendum is to clarify the parties’ agreed service arrangement, performance expectations, responsibilities, and business protections.

If this Addendum expressly conflicts with the rest of the Client Services Agreement on a matter this Addendum addresses, this Addendum controls on that matter only. Section 10 (Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability) and Section 12 (Dispute Resolution) continue to apply to this Addendum. All other provisions of the Client Services Agreement remain unchanged.
The parties agree to the following customized arrangement for the initial three-month engagement:

items.bullet: Month 1: 20 hours per week of virtual assistant services.
Month 2: 15 hours per week of virtual assistant services.
Month 3: 15 hours per week of virtual assistant services.

Pricing: $950 per month for each of the three months, including the additional month 1 hours above the Starter cap at no added cost. After month 3, Client may renew on the Starter plan or upgrade to the Essential plan, in either case under the terms of the Client Services Agreement. On the Starter plan, hours are 15 per week unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.

Scope of Services: Hours of service toward the business goals Client has expressed to Relève and that are written out in Client’s 90-Day Success Plan. These hours are Relève’s only commitment about the work. Relève does not commit to any particular deliverable, volume of output, or business result.

items.p: Client buys hours of service from Relève, not the services of a particular individual. Relève may assign Talent to provide the hours and may change which Talent provide them under the Client Services Agreement. The hours, rate, and minimum term in this Addendum apply to the engagement as a whole, and the Talent who perform the work log it in the Relève platform.

The parties acknowledge that the first month’s 20-hour weekly arrangement is a mutually agreed exception to the standard Starter plan’s 15-hour weekly cap under Section 3.3 of the Client Services Agreement.

The agreed hours are the hours Relève schedules each week, excluding Client’s mutually approved time off and applicable holidays. Any change to the agreed hours, pricing, or scope of services requires mutual written approval.
The parties confirm the working schedule and monthly pricing in the Placement Schedule before services begin.

Relève shall provide reasonable oversight of the Talent who provide the hours, to support timely progress on the goals in Client’s 90-Day Success Plan. Relève does not guarantee any business result, including response rates, booked calls, or audience growth.
The following expectations apply:

items.bullet: The Talent log their hours and tasks in the Relève platform, and Relève reports hours worked, tasks completed, and outstanding items to Client weekly.
Clear communication regarding deadlines, priorities, and progress.
Timely notice of interruptions or delays that may affect the work.
Reasonable opportunities for Client to request revisions or corrections when completed work does not meet agreed expectations.

items.p: If the agreed hours are not provided due to circumstances within Relève’s control, Relève will first offer make-up hours within thirty (30) days. If it cannot, Client receives a service credit equal to the monthly rate divided by the scheduled hours for that month, multiplied by the hours missed, as shown in the Relève platform record. The credit is applied as a deduction on Client’s next invoice and is not a refund. No credit is owed for days that are a Vacancy under Section 4.3 of the Client Services Agreement, for Client’s approved time off, applicable holidays, Client’s own delays, or Talent absence that Relève has notified and handled under its normal process, and the credit in any month cannot exceed that month’s fee. Make-up hours or the credit are Client’s sole remedy for missed hours.

If material performance issues remain unresolved after written notice and a ten-business-day opportunity to correct them, and Relève has not within that period resolved them or presented a Replacement candidate for Client’s review under Section 4.2 of the Client Services Agreement, Client may end the engagement without responsibility for future service fees under the remaining minimum term.

items.sub: A3. Ownership of Content and Business Assets

items.p: Refynity retains full ownership of its existing and original business materials, branding, social media accounts, marketing content, customer information, CRM records, and other proprietary business assets.

All original work product created specifically for Refynity under the engagement is assigned to Refynity upon payment of the applicable fees, subject to any clearly disclosed third-party licensing restrictions.
Upon termination or completion of services, Relève shall provide:

items.bullet: Editable source files for materials created specifically for Refynity.
Access to relevant business files and records.
Reasonably necessary transition and handoff materials.

items.p: These materials shall be provided within five business days of termination or completion of the engagement, subject to payment of undisputed amounts due.

items.sub: A4. Confidentiality, Data Protection, and AI Tools

items.p: Relève shall require, by written agreement, that the Talent who provide the hours maintain confidentiality regarding Refynity’s proprietary business information, client and prospect information, credentials, and internal operations. Each Talent signs a written non-disclosure and confidentiality agreement with Relève before receiving any Client Confidential Information, and Client may rely on it as stated in Section 5.3 of the Client Services Agreement.
Client Confidential Information shall not be entered into AI tools that Client has not approved in writing, and shall not be used for purposes unrelated to providing the agreed services.

Relève shall require that Talent promptly discontinue access to Refynity’s systems when their assignment ends, and shall reasonably cooperate with Refynity in transferring access, returning business information, and securely deleting confidential data, except where retention is legally required.

Each party remains responsible for its own negligence, misconduct, violations of applicable law, and material breaches of the Client Services Agreement, subject to Section 10 of the Client Services Agreement.
Relève remains responsible for its obligations under the Client Services Agreement concerning the engagement, payment, and support of Talent, to the extent required by applicable law.

Client remains responsible for its business decisions, lawful instructions, approval of published content, supervision of day-to-day assigned tasks, and its business and social media accounts, including compliance with each platform’s terms. Relève is not liable for platform restrictions on those accounts.
Neither party is required to indemnify the other for losses to the extent caused by the other party’s negligence or misconduct.

items.sub: A6. Communication and Resolution of Concerns

items.p: Both parties agree to communicate promptly and in good faith regarding service concerns, performance expectations, or changes in business needs.
Where reasonable, concerns are first addressed through direct communication with Relève’s designated Client Success Manager.
Relève shall respond to a written notice of a material service deficiency within ten business days with a resolution or a corrective plan, unless the circumstances require more immediate action.
Nothing in this Addendum limits Client’s existing rights under the Client Services Agreement concerning serious misconduct, confidentiality breaches, or replacement of Talent.
This Addendum is part of the Client Services Agreement and takes effect when Client accepts the Client Services Agreement electronically under Section 13.11.
